What each heading means

Heading on this pageMeaningCat-wise list field
Total tanksUnderground tanks at the site.No of Tanks
Service ports availableTanks marked CAT1. Each already has a usable service port, so no socket is needed.Cat = CAT1
CAT2 / CAT3 tanksTanks without a usable service port. These are the tanks that need a socket.Cat = CAT2 / CAT3
Sites fully readyEvery tank at the site is CAT1.All Cat cells = CAT1
Ports requiredSockets to install. In 627 of 656 sites this equals the number of CAT2 + CAT3 tanks. Where no figure was recorded but Stingray has installed ports, the installed number is used.Socket Required at Tanks
Installed by StingraySockets Stingray has already installed. Not in the cat-wise list, so taken from the port survey workbook.—
Still to installPorts required minus installed by Stingray.—
